BTech AI & ML Student at Zenith School of AI | Aspiring AI Engineer | Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

1d

Becoming the CR of my class at Zenith School of AI in the very first semester was something I didn’t expect when I first came to college. It feels good to know that my classmates trusted me with this responsibility.

For me, being a CR is not just about representing the class. It’s about listening to everyone, communicating properly, helping whenever I can, and making sure everyone’s voice is heard.

This is a new responsibility and a new learning experience for me. I’m looking forward to improving myself, taking initiative, and becoming better with every challenge.

“Leadership is not about being the best, it’s about bringing out the best in others.”

A new role, a new responsibility, and another step forward.
